paths.title: Sainted General
paths.description: Lead a luminous counterattack, turning a successful strike into a chance to spend an action point on an ally's recovery. Your healing eventually lets companions add radiant power to their attacks, while a blazing corona can blind surrounding enemies and leave you free to strike one still able to see. A field of holy light offers allies strength, protection, or healing, and your greatest rally sends the whole nearby company into a shared melee assault.

paths.title: Arkhosian Blademaster
paths.description: Keep your company fighting past the point where its strength should have failed, lending nearby allies temporary health as your blade lands. Your own reserves run deeper, and second wind eventually restores a spent encounter attack, while spending an action point helps your companions finish bloodied enemies. A sweeping assault can draw enemy attention onto you and return encounter attacks to several allies, rewarding a battle in which you have already spent your encouragement freely.

paths.title: Battle Captain
paths.description: Seize the opening moments of battle, giving nearby allies the accuracy to make their first attacks count. Your action points sharpen the company's attacks again, and later your inspiring word sends a recovered ally back into the fight with better accuracy and speed, especially under Tactical Presence. Forceful strikes clear space around the enemy line, while a moment of inspired command lets an ally bring a spent encounter attack back into play.

paths.title: Battlelord of Kord
paths.description: Lead with a fearless surge, lending force and accuracy to your companions when you spend an action point. Your inspiring word can urge a wounded ally into a stronger attack, though a failed opening leaves that ally exposed, and your killing stroke can set off a chain of attacks as companions bring down foes in turn. Resistance to fear and enemy marks helps you keep moving, while your greatest maneuver carries you through several enemies in a storm of individual blows.

paths.title: Captain of Fortune
paths.description: Make good fortune look like sound command, smoothing out poor weapon damage rolls and giving allies the chance to roll attacks or damage again. Your action point attacks provide temporary health to you or nearby companions, and later you can spend two action points in one encounter across different rounds. When a dangerous enemy needs its luck broken, your lasting mark forces it to risk the worse of two attack rolls whenever it turns on an ally.

paths.title: Infernal Strategist
paths.description: Arrange the fight so that an enemy caught between you and an ally pays for every exposed flank. Your action points can rescue an ally's failed attack, and a second Commanding Presence eventually gives you more ways to shape the company's decisive moments. Feints undermine enemy accuracy, while flexible orders let an ally's action point become the occasion for healing, a stronger attack, or a daring extra maneuver.

paths.title: Knight Commander
paths.description: Become the armored center of the advance, giving companions beside you the confidence to strike more accurately. Your action points reinforce the company's defenses, and nearby opportunity attacks eventually gain extra force, making a tightly held line dangerous to cross. Your own attacks drive enemies back or draw them into your marks, while your greatest assault leaves surrounding foes bleeding and makes that suffering harder to shake while they remain beside you.

paths.title: Longarm Marshal
paths.description: Keep a spear poised between the enemy and your company, striking with greater accuracy and extending your reach when you spend an action point. With experience, careless movement and ranged attacks within that reach become chances to deal damage, while powerful thrusts push troublesome foes away. A defensive stance steadies your guard, and a deep, lingering wound makes every subsequent melee or ranged hit against your chosen target more punishing.

paths.title: Pack Master
paths.description: Hunt as a company, closing quickly and giving your companions the actions and movement they need to surround the prey. You can spend your own action point on an ally's turn in the spotlight, while cunning attacks lure enemies into striking each other and expose a victim to an ally's follow-up. When the formation needs to change, you can scatter willing companions clear of danger or sustain a veil of concealment over the whole pack.

paths.title: Twiceborn Leader
paths.description: Keep two companions in the fight with one inspiring word, trading its usual extra healing for a wider rally. Your action points lend nearby allies greater accuracy, and their second winds eventually bring stronger protection, making recovery part of the company's advance. A shared stance lets you and one ally choose the better of two attack rolls each turn, while your greatest assault rewards companions who have already caught their breath with a fresh opening to strike.
